meta.title: Multiple PO Split: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify whether Multiple PO Split is refused or absent.
Repeat Multiple PO Split as a Buyer and verify that it is available.
Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan and record any intentional RBAC configuration.
